references.text: Here Arod (Arodi) is mentioned as one of Gad's sons who went to Egypt with Jacob. This is the genealogical origin of the clan of the Arodites mentioned in Numbers 26:17.
The first census of the tribe of Gad in the wilderness, which provides the background for the clans counted in the second census in Numbers 26.
The complete list of Gad's clans in the second census, where Arod and Areli are included among Gad's descendants.
